title: arenaria serpyllifolia var. patula
intro: Arenaria serpyllifolia var. patula, commonly known as Sandwort or Corn Spurry, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Sandwort include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Sandwort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative agent.
